issues.description: The running size accumulator and `if (size > limit) throw PayloadTooLargeError()` check were removed, so the entire stream is buffered into memory with no cap. An untrusted/large upload now drives unbounded memory growth (OOM / DoS). The `limit` parameter is now dead, a tell that the guard was dropped.
The `limit` parameter and `size` variable are now unused after the cap check was removed.
contract ambiguity of what zero or negative limit values mean
